actions.description: Turn one private CRM builder-chat request into a validated, reviewable team-agent version without deploying it.

input.message:
Build a recurring CRM agent that runs once per day and produces a daily summary of new contacts that still need research.

PURPOSE
Each day, surface a concise "new contacts" digest so a rep can see what entered the queue overnight and what research is still pending. This is a read-only summarization agent — it must NOT mutate any CRM record (no writing briefs, no setting socials, no scheduling rechecks).

WHAT IT SHOULD DO (each run)
1. Call list_outstanding_work with limit 25. This returns CRM contacts that still lack research: missing real name, missing a Background brief, or socials never looked for. Each row includes id, fullName, email, title, companyName, companyDomain, linkedinUrl, and a "needs" object with booleans {identity, brief, socials}.
2. If the response's count equals the limit (25), it is likely truncated — note this in the output so a rep knows the queue may be larger.

OUTPUT SHAPE (the agent must return this structured summary)
- totalContacts: number — the count returned by list_outstanding_work.
- possiblyTruncated: boolean — true when count equals the requested limit (25), meaning more may exist.
- byTitle: array of { title: string, count: number } — group contacts by their title, sorted descending by count.
- byCompany: array of { company: string, count: number } — group contacts by companyName, sorted descending by count.
- byMissingWork: object with three counts:
    - missingIdentity: number (contacts where needs.identity is true)
    - missingBrief: number (contacts where needs.brief is true)
    - missingSocials: number (contacts where needs.socials is true)
- notables: array of { fullName: string, title: string, company: string, email: string } — the contacts the rep should look at first: any whose title is one of {CTO, COO, Chief of Staff, Head of Security, Head of Legal, IT Director, Head of Platform}, capped at 10 entries. If fewer than 10 match, do not pad with lower-priority titles.
- vietnamRealEstateFlag: boolean — true when any contact's companyDomain ends in ".vn" AND companyName contains BĐS/real-estate keywords in Vietnamese (e.g. "Địa ốc", "Bất Động Sản", "Nhà Đất", "Sàn Giao Dịch"). Include the matching contact names in a field vietnamRealEstateContacts: array of { fullName, company }.

CONSTRAINTS
- Read-only. No CRM mutation tools, no research_person, no web_search, no enrich_company. The single data source is list_outstanding_work.
- Output must be in Vietnamese for any free-text labels, but field names and company/title values stay as-is from the CRM.
- Keep the run cheap: one list_outstanding_work call per run. Do not paginate further.
- The agent runs on a daily schedule; design it to finish quickly.
